back: Boar = breeding male; sow = female that has farrowed; gilt = young female not yet farrowed.
Large White (erect ears), Landrace (drooping ears, long), Duroc (red-brown), Hampshire (black, white band), Mukota (indigenous, hardy).
Oestrous cycle about 21 days; heat 2-3 days; standing reflex; gestation about 114 days (3 months, 3 weeks, 3 days).
Given at about 3 days: piglets have low iron stores, sow's milk is low in iron and concrete floors give no soil iron, so they become anaemic.
Crate prevents the sow crushing piglets; the heated creep area keeps piglets warm and lets them eat creep feed.
365 ÷ (114 + lactation days + days from weaning to service).
Day 1 teeth clipped; about day 3 iron; castration within 2 weeks; creep from 1-2 weeks; weaning about 4-8 weeks.
Raw meat scraps can carry African swine fever and foot-and-mouth disease.
